Container.Name: mist-docker
Container.Overview: Mist v2 in your browser. Artists upload their images, the server adds a faint adversarial noise that makes AI models scramble any attempt to copy the style or content, and they download the protected images (or a zip). Runs on an NVIDIA GPU (install the Nvidia Driver plugin, driver 570 or newer, and keep --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters). Expect a few minutes per image on a mid-range card; on the CPU it is far slower. The Stable Diffusion 1.5 model (about 5 GB) downloads into the data folder on first start, and the first job also makes a few comparison images. Uploaded images are deleted after an hour. There is no login unless you set a password below, so keep it on your LAN or put it behind a reverse proxy. Mist is a deterrent, not a guarantee.
Container.Requires: Install the Nvidia Driver plugin. No GPU? Remove --runtime=nvidia from Extra Parameters and it runs on the CPU, very slowly.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Model cache (about 5 GB), comparison images and temporary job files.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which GPU to use: all, or a GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin page.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the page asks for it. Leave empty for no login.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Optional username to go with the password. Empty means the username is mist.

Config.Name: Max images per run
Config.Description: How many images one run may contain. Each run holds the GPU, so keep this small on shared servers.

Config.Name: Max image side (px)
Config.Description: Uploads larger than this on their longest side are shrunk before processing.

Config.Name: Queue length
Config.Description: How many runs may wait their turn before new ones are turned away.

Config.Name: Comparison images
Config.Description: Comparison images generated on the first run and reused afterwards. Upstream uses 50; fewer makes the first run quicker.

Config.Name: Delete uploads after (minutes)
Config.Description: How long uploaded and finished images stay on the server before they are removed.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns created files (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns created files (100 = users).
